New Features:[/color][/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Improved previous translations for better understanding by English speakers (Enhanced Localization).[/size]
[*][size=3]Added +700 new dialogues covering Single, Marriage, and Festival interactions.[/size]
[*][size=3]Added 15 new heart events.[/size]
[*][size=3]Added new mail and quest content.[/size]
[*][size=3]Added an option to manually set Caroline's relationship status as "Single" at the start via "Forced Single" config.[/size]
[*][size=3]Added a spouse portrait (furniture) and spouse weapon.[/size]
[*][size=3]Compatibility with other portrait mods like Seasonal Cute Portraits without overlap. [/size]
[size=3]Caroline's "older sister" portraits can be toggleable to be disabled via "Sorkrim Art" setting.
[/size][/list][size=3]
[color=#ffff00][b]Changed Mod Features:[/b][/color]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Since Caroline is married to Pierre, unlocking her "single" status requires progressing through her story.[/size]
[size=3](Or you can manually set it via config)[/size][*][size=3]Scene and Dialogue changes with 4 and 10 Heart Events while preserving their original story.[/size]
[*][size=3]Removed the original 6 Heart Heart, the event where Abigail is pimping her mom to the farmer.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[color=#ff0000][b]Features of the original mod that were left unchanged:[/b][/color]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]2-Heart Event (CG Event).[/size]
[*][size=3]Caroline's other Vanilla Content, including Vanilla Heart Events, Gift Tastes, and Schedule.[/size]
[*][size=3]Seasonal outfits for Caroline and other outfits including: [/size]
[size=3]Aerobics Outfit, Flower Dance Dress, Spirit's Eve Costume, and Ginger island outfit.[/size][/list][size=3]
[color=#ff00ff][b]Planned Features: [/b][/color][/size][spoiler][list]
[*][size=3]Event additions: "If Abigail is married to the player", Anniversaries, Body Arc, and more Beach events.[/size]
[*][size=3]Possible epilogue for Pierre.[/size]
[*][size=3]Additional support for Rasmodia The Witch Mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Additional support for SVE mature events. [/size][/spoiler]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Recommended Mods:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505][size=3]Event Lookup[/size][/url]
[size=2]Helps you check how to trigger in-game events. Very useful for seeing when and where events will happen.[/size][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19305][size=3]Schedule Viewer[/size]﻿[/url][b] [/b][size=3]AND/OR[/size] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541][b][size=3]Lookup Anything[/size][/b][/url]
[size=2]﻿[/size][size=2]Caroline has new schedules after marriage. These mods help you track her location easily.

[/size][/list][b]Compatible or Not?[/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#00ff00]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), Ridgeside Valley (RSV), and East Scarp (ES)[/color][/size]
[size=2]Most heart events occur indoors, while some outdoor events were set in fixed locations. I added a feature to use the Vanilla Location on Caroline's Heart Events even with SVE installed due to burnout, with plans to relocate events to SVE locations later. This forced location feature won't affect Vanilla and other modded content.
[/size][*][color=#00ff00][size=3]Professor Jasper Thomas (and other Museum NPCs)[/size][/color]
CG no longer breaks the Museum[*][color=#ffff00][size=3]Hitme's Caroline Is Single (Immersive Caroline Divorce)[/size][/color]
Installing both won't cause any issues, but due to the amount of people getting confused over the content, it's now semi-compatible. My mod focuses on the childhood aspect, not the divorce. Also, you have to delete the Marriage Dialogue.json file at [CP] Caroline Is Single > Data > Dialogue > MarriageDialogue.json. If you don't want to, just turn off my Marriage Dialogues using the config.[/list][size=3]
